notes:
Lead origin: self-serve signup (trial) via /signup; inbound from YC-demo day blog mention. Short company background: building an embedded in-app chat assistant for their B2B analytics platform (SaaS). Focused on live streaming replies in product UI (token-by-token) to keep perceived latency low. Team is small (PM + 2 full-time eng + 1 ML/infra contractor).

Key requirements (from calls):
- Streaming API support mandatory (ui streams token/partial answers). p50 latency target <150ms for short context flows (welcome + FAQ). p95 goal <400ms.
- Throughput low initially (concurrent 20-50 users), but bursts welcome. Cost-sensitive: want predictable per-token billing and suggestions to optimize costs.
- Prefers public cloud hosted offering for fast rollout; open to Dedicated later. No on-prem or air-gapped need now.
- Security: SSO (SAML) required for admin portal, audit logs for access to production prompts. SOC2 mention — they expect vendor SOC2 or equivalent.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller, fast decoder models (quantized OK) with deterministic fallback to slightly larger models for long tail. Interested in Redwood suggestions for batching + prefix caching.
